# SOP-P1-L3-05 Planned shutdown - Machining line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, EQ-P1-L3-CN03

1. Preconditions
   1. Ensure production hold is recorded in MES and line is scheduled for planned shutdown.
   2. Confirm maintenance permits are active and communicated to operations and safety.
   3. Verify that the target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C and that heater control is set to safe cooldown mode.
   4. Isolate energy sources to EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, and EQ-P1-L3-CN03 per lockout/tagout.

2. Personal protective equipment (PPE)
   1. Wear safety glasses, face shield, hearing protection, heat-resistant gloves, and steel-toe footwear.
   2. Use insulated gloves when working on hot systems or when verifying the induction heater and when handling tooling from the press.

3. Shutdown procedure
   1. Stop feed and hold workpieces clear of machining and forging areas.
   2. Execute controlled cooldown for furnace and induction heater until verified at target billet temperature of 1235 °C or below for safe handling.
   3. Depressurize hydraulic circuits and bleed hydraulic accumulators on EQ-P1-L3-HP02.
   4. When access to the press is granted, verify main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is set to 1330 N·m as part of pre-service checks.
   5. Secure tooling and remove chips and debris from cell using approved methods.

4. Verification and returning to service
   1. Complete post-shutdown inspection checklist and corrective actions.
   2. Test machine functions under maintenance control prior to re-energizing.
   3. Restore energy sources only after all personnel and tools are clear.

5. Sign-off
   1. Maintenance lead, shift supervisor, and safety officer shall sign to confirm completion of shutdown, verification of the specified temperatures and torque, and release for restart.

Related documents: ECN-2026-021, ECN-2026-029, ECN-2026-043
